item.title: Winter tells supporters: Don’t be swayed by the pressure, we are the right
item.description: At a rally for his new party, Ofer Winter tells activists, “Don’t be swayed by the pressure. We represent the true voice of the Israeli people and will sit with Netanyahu."

item.title: IDF: Interceptors fired towards suspicious aerial target, the results are under review
item.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said that following the sirens that sounded a short while ago regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in several areas in northern Israel, interceptors were launched toward a suspicious aerial target that likely crossed from Lebanon into Israeli territory. The interception results are under review. No injuries were reported.
Missile and rocket alerts were activated due to the interception attempts.

item.title: 'We are strengthening our friendship': Netanyahu, Herzog welcome Congo President
item.description: Netanyahu and Herzog meet Congo President Tshisekedi as Israel and the DRC agree to strengthen economic, security and diplomatic ties.

item.title: IDF: UAV incident in Galilee panhandle has ended, under investigation
item.description:
The IDF said that the aircraft intrusion incident in the Galilee panhandle has ended and is currently being investigated.
At this time, there is no change in the assessment of the situation. No special instructions have been issued to the public, and schools and student transportation will operate as usual.

item.title: Trump: I couldn't care less If Iran signs a 'worthless' agreement
item.description: President Trump rejects reports he is forcing Iran back to talks, saying he prefers the US position: Their economy is totally collapsing.

item.title: IRGC claims: We attacked US bases in Iraq; explosions heard in Jordan
item.description:
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed it carried out a combined missile and drone attack against US bases in Erbil, Iraq.
Meanwhile, explosions were heard again in Jordan.

item.title: Judge sends Charlie Kirk murder case to trial, killer could face death penalty
item.description: A Utah judge rules Tyler Robinson will stand trial for aggravated murder in Charlie Kirk's 2025 shooting, a charge that could bring the death penalty.

item.title: Bahrain: Iranian drones intercepted and destroyed over the kingdom
item.description: Bahrain announced that the country’s air defense systems intercepted and destroyed Iranian drones over the kingdom.

item.title: IAEA: Syrian site struck by Israel in 2007 consistent with a nuclear reactor
item.description: The IAEA says a Syrian site bombed by Israel in 2007 held infrastructure consistent with a nuclear reactor and that Assad-era authorities failed to declare nuclear activities.

item.title: Sirens sound in Bahrain, Interior Ministry warns of 'possible threat'
item.description:
Sirens sounded in Bahrain overnight, according to local reports.
Bahrain’s Interior Ministry issued a warning of a “possible threat" and called on citizens and residents to move to a safe location.

item.title: New European initiative could hurt Israel
item.description: A new EU initiative calls for changing foreign policy decision-making, replacing unanimity with qualified-majority voting.

item.title: CENTCOM announces completion of latest wave of strikes against Iran
item.description:
US Central Command (CENTCOM) announced that its forces successfully completed the latest wave of strikes against Iranian military targets.
“US forces struck Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targets including air defense sites, radar systems, maritime assets and facilities, mine laying capabilities, and communications sites," it said.

item.title: Explosions heard in Kuwait following Iranian missile and drone attack
item.description:
Explosions were heard in Kuwait early Wednesday morning.
The Kuwaiti army later stated that the country's air defenses are engaging Iranian ballistic missiles and drones.

item.title: Reports in Iran of drone strikes on a US base in Bahrain
item.description:
Iranian media reported overnight that Tehran attacked a US military base in Bahrain using drones.
Reuters noted that there has been no official confirmation of the report at this time.
